invariants.description: stoichiometry: n_H H+ out and 1 ATP -> ADP + Pi per turnover; the current is the pumped charge, i = -F j_H_pumped (exact)
invariants.expr: np.allclose(j_H_pumped, n_H*j_ATP_H, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(j_ADP_H, -j_ATP_H, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(j_Pi_H, -j_ATP_H, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(i_H_ATPase, -F*j_H_pumped*1e9, rtol=1e-12, atol=0)

invariants.description: second law: it hydrolyses ATP only while the ATP free energy exceeds the proton work, v (A_ATP - W_H) >= 0 (and synthesises ATP otherwise)
